forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {見舞|みま}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to visit (a sick or injured person), to pay a sympathy call
definitions.explanation: To visit someone who is ill, injured, or has experienced misfortune, in order to offer comfort and support.

definitions.gloss: to strike, to hit, to befall
definitions.explanation: Used when a disaster, calamity, or blow strikes a person or place. Often appears in passive form (見舞われる).

examples.japanese: ⟦{入院|にゅういん}した→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見舞|みま}う。
⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to visit at the hospital with flowers.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the original meaning and is often used as the noun ⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧ (a visit to a sick person, a get-well gift). Sense 2 appears almost exclusively in the passive form {見舞|みま}われる, typically with natural disasters or crises as the subject.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go visit (a sick person)
- ⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧: visitor (to a sick person)
- ⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧: get-well visit/gift (polite form)
- ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われる: to be struck by a disaster
- ⟦{不幸|ふこう}→不幸：03595_fukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞|みま}われる: to be visited by misfortune
